Persistent per-character voice tags for eleven_v3, prepended by lab/tools/build_directed.py to every segment that CHARACTER speaks. Not per-beat direction: an accent is a property of the whole performance, so it sits once at the head of the line, ahead of whatever register tag the first beat carries. Narration segments (~gN) are spoken by the narrator and never take a character's prefix.

Hong Kong deliberately does NOT carry a blanket Cantonese prefix. Its char_notes ask for an accent in only a handful of cases, and the ones that do are already served better by casting: Racter is cast on a Russian voice, Gaichu a Japanese one, Rainbow on an Irish-accented English voice, because the catalog HAS those and a real accent beats a tag asking for one. A prefix is for an accent the pool cannot supply. Add them here as each character is auditioned rather than all at once on theory - the same policy Dragonfall's file states.
